# Zoom Clips

<!-- WARNING: THIS FILE WAS AUTOGENERATED! DO NOT EDIT! -->

[Zoom Clips](https://www.zoom.com/en/products/video-recording/) lets you easily capture video and screen content. You can quickly share recordings and allow others to comment and react. As a result, you can extend the conversation and encourage collaboration.

## Showcase product features

Zoom Clips is ideal to demonstrate product features or showcase app functionality. You can easily share visual content and engage your audience.

## Integrate Zoom Clips into your apps

You can use Zoom Clips APIs to extend its capabilities, such as integrating Zoom Clips into third-party applications or services. You can also build both private services and public apps on the [Zoom App Marketplace](http://marketplace.zoom.us/).

## Get started with OAuth 2.0 for Zoom

To use Zoom Clips APIs, you'll need credentials. Follow the [OAuth 2.0 for Zoom](/docs/integrations/oauth/) guide to learn how to obtain credentials and start developing private or public applications.
